primary_endpoint: Relative change from baseline to Week 36 in liver fat content by MRI-PDFF.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 36, LFC changed by −22.900%, −18.590%, and −21.335% with PXL065 7.5, 15, and 22.5 mg QD, respectively, versus +2.413% with placebo; reported ANCOVA p-values were 0.0083, 0.0237, and 0.0087, respectively.
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 1/25, 3/32, and 1/30 participants receiving PXL065 7.5, 15, and 22.5 mg QD, respectively, versus 2/30 with placebo; deaths were 0, 0, 0, and 1, respectively.
